messages:
Ava: Morning—noticed the silver canister smells a bit stale. Someone must have topped it with an old espresso bag. Can we do an "opened on" sticker rule?
Diego: Yep saw that too. Also my granola box from yesterday is half gone  did anyone take a second helping?
Sam: That was me at 10am, sorry! Should've left a note. Sticker rule sounds great.
Ava: Cool. Quick little experiment: sticker pad at the printer, plus a tiny calendar slot for "kitchen check" on Fridays 4pm. Reply yes/no to the sticker pad.
Diego: yes :+1:
Sam: yes, and I can take the first kitchen check next Friday.
kitchen-bot: Printer job completed at 11:22 by Priya. 20 labels printed.
Ava: Ill leave a small pen and label pad by the sink. Also can we standardize non-dairy jugs labeling? Almond/ Oat/ Soy + name.
Diego: Promise to stop a stealth almond-milk swap. :sweat_smile:
Sam: Thanks y'all. Granola replenished note on the board. Thread closed.
